description: This file defines the SugarTinyMCE class, a PHP wrapper for configuring and initializing the TinyMCE WYSIWYG HTML editor within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for generating configuration arrays, JavaScript initialization code, and handling custom configurations and language settings.

classes.name: SugarTinyMCE
classes.description: PHP wrapper class for configuring and initializing TinyMCE editor instances, including support for custom configs, language settings, and HTML cleaning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarTinyMCE object, loading custom button configurations, default configs, and language settings.

methods.name: resolveConfigType
methods.description: Resolves legacy config type aliases to semantic config names.

methods.name: validateConfigType
methods.description: Validates that the config type is one of the allowed types ('extended', 'standard', 'minimal'), defaults to 'standard' if invalid.

methods.name: buildConfig
methods.description: Builds a TinyMCE configuration array based on the specified type.

methods.name: getConfigArray
methods.description: Returns the TinyMCE configuration array for a given type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to initialize a TinyMCE instance on specified DOM elements.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code defining the TinyMCE configuration object.

methods.name: cleanEncodedMCEHtml
methods.description: Cleans TinyMCE-specific HTML code, removing editor-specific attributes.

methods.name: overloadButtonConfigs
methods.description: Loads custom button configurations from an external PHP file if available.

methods.name: overloadDefaultConfigs
methods.description: Loads custom default configurations from an external PHP file if available.

methods.name: overloadLanguageConfigs
methods.description: Sets language URL and code based on current language if custom language file exists.
